{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module SearchIndex where

import System.Directory
import System.FilePath
import System.IO
import Control.Monad (when, unless, forM_)
import Data.List (isPrefixOf, isInfixOf)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import System.Posix.Files (getSymbolicLinkStatus, isSymbolicLink, fileExist)
import qualified System.Posix.Files as Posix

type TenantId = String
type DocId = String
type IndexContent = String

data IndexConfig = IndexConfig
  { baseDir     :: FilePath
  , maxDocSize  :: Int
  , allowedExts :: [String]
  }

defaultConfig :: IndexConfig
defaultConfig = IndexConfig
  { baseDir     = "/var/searchindex"
  , maxDocSize  = 1048576
  , allowedExts = [".txt", ".md", ".json"]
  }

-- Resolve tenant directory with isolation check
resolveTenantDir :: IndexConfig -> TenantId -> IO (Either String FilePath)
resolveTenantDir cfg tid = do
  let tenantDir = baseDir cfg </> "tenants" </> tid
  exists <- doesDirectoryExist tenantDir
  if not exists
    then return $ Left "Tenant directory does not exist"
    else do
      canonical <- canonicalizePath tenantDir
      let base = baseDir cfg </> "tenants"
      baseCanon <- canonicalizePath base
      if baseCanon `isPrefixOf` canonical
        then return $ Right canonical
        else return $ Left "Tenant directory escapes base path"

-- Validate document path within tenant boundary
validateDocPath :: FilePath -> TenantId -> IndexConfig -> IO (Either String FilePath)
validateDocPath docPath tid cfg = do
  tenantResult <- resolveTenantDir cfg tid
  case tenantResult of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right tenantDir -> do
      let fullPath = tenantDir </> "documents" </> docPath
      -- Check for path traversal in the requested path
      let normalized = normalizeDocPath docPath
      if ".." `isInfixOf` normalized
        then return $ Left "Path traversal detected"
        else do
          -- Verify the target exists and resolve
          pathExists <- doesPathExist fullPath
          if not pathExists
            then return $ Left "Document not found"
            else do
              resolved <- canonicalizePath fullPath
              if tenantDir `isPrefixOf` resolved
                then return $ Right resolved
                else return $ Left "Document escapes tenant boundary"

normalizeDocPath :: FilePath -> FilePath
normalizeDocPath = joinPath . filter (not . null) . splitPath

-- Index a document for a tenant
indexDocument :: IndexConfig -> TenantId -> DocId -> FilePath -> IO (Either String ())
indexDocument cfg tid docId sourcePath = do
  validated <- validateDocPath sourcePath tid cfg
  case validated of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right resolvedSource -> do
      content <- readFile resolvedSource
      let size = length content
      if size > maxDocSize cfg
        then return $ Left "Document exceeds maximum size"
        else do
          tenantResult <- resolveTenantDir cfg tid
          case tenantResult of
            Left err -> return $ Left err
            Right tenantDir -> do
              let indexDir = tenantDir </> "index"
              createDirectoryIfMissing True indexDir
              let indexFile = indexDir </> docId
              writeIndexEntry indexFile content
              return $ Right ()

-- Write index entry - creates a staging file then moves it
writeIndexEntry :: FilePath -> IndexContent -> IO ()
writeIndexEntry target content = do
  let staging = target ++ ".staging"
  writeFile staging content
  -- Atomic rename for consistency
  renameFile staging target

-- Batch reindex: walks tenant document directory and reindexes all
batchReindex :: IndexConfig -> TenantId -> IO (Either String Int)
batchReindex cfg tid = do
  tenantResult <- resolveTenantDir cfg tid
  case tenantResult of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right tenantDir -> do
      let docDir = tenantDir </> "documents"
      docDirExists <- doesDirectoryExist docDir
      if not docDirExists
        then return $ Left "No documents directory"
        else do
          entries <- listDirectory docDir
          count <- newIORef (0 :: Int)
          forM_ entries $ \entry -> do
            let fullEntry = docDir </> entry
            -- Security: check each entry is not a symlink before processing
            status <- getSymbolicLinkStatus fullEntry
            unless (isSymbolicLink status) $ do
              let ext = takeExtension entry
              when (ext `elem` allowedExts cfg) $ do
                -- Re-validate at read time for TOCTOU safety
                finalPath <- canonicalizePath fullEntry
                when (tenantDir `isPrefixOf` finalPath) $ do
                  result <- indexDocument cfg tid (takeBaseName entry) entry
                  case result of
                    Right () -> modifyIORef' count (+1)
                    Left _   -> return ()
          indexed <- readIORef count
          return $ Right indexed

-- Cross-tenant search (admin only) - reads from index directories
crossTenantSearch :: IndexConfig -> [TenantId] -> String -> IO (Map.Map TenantId [DocId])
crossTenantSearch cfg tids query = do
  results <- newIORef Map.empty
  forM_ tids $ \tid -> do
    tenantResult <- resolveTenantDir cfg tid
    case tenantResult of
      Left _ -> return ()
      Right tenantDir -> do
        let indexDir = tenantDir </> "index"
        indexExists <- doesDirectoryExist indexDir
        when indexExists $ do
          entries <- listDirectory indexDir
          matches <- newIORef []
          forM_ entries $ \entry -> do
            let indexFile = indexDir </> entry
            -- Read index file to check for query match
            content <- readFile indexFile
            when (query `isInfixOf` content) $
              modifyIORef' matches (entry:)
          found <- readIORef matches
          unless (null found) $
            modifyIORef' results (Map.insert tid found)
  readIORef results

-- Purge tenant data with safety checks
purgeTenantIndex :: IndexConfig -> TenantId -> IO (Either String ())
purgeTenantIndex cfg tid = do
  tenantResult <- resolveTenantDir cfg tid
  case tenantResult of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right tenantDir -> do
      let indexDir = tenantDir </> "index"
      indexExists <- doesDirectoryExist indexDir
      if not indexExists
        then return $ Right ()
        else do
          entries <- listDirectory indexDir
          forM_ entries $ \entry -> do
            let fp = indexDir </> entry
            status <- getSymbolicLinkStatus fp
            -- Only remove regular files, skip symlinks for safety
            when (Posix.isRegularFile status) $
              removeFile fp
          return $ Right ()
